findings.provider: The Pokémon Company International official press site (pokemon.gamespress.com, France)
findings.excerpt: Dès le 31 octobre, les Dresseurs souhaitant jouer avec l’extension Épée et Bouclier – Voltage Éclatant avant sa sortie officielle pourront se procurer un Boîtier Stratégies et Combats d’ Épée et Bouclier – Voltage Éclatant dans les magasins participants. Chaque boîtier contient [...] dont une des quatre cartes promo à illustration alternative
findings.identityMatch: French Ronflex SWSH068 is the Boîtier Stratégies et Combats Voltage Éclatant promo per Poképédia card page (raw/pokepedia-ronflex-swsh068.json: 'numerocarte=SWSH068' ... 'Cette carte était disponible dans le [[Boîtier Stratégies et Combats Épée et Bouclier Voltage Éclatant]]'). Release article dated 28/08/2020, France locale.
findings.notes: Ordinary (non-Staff) French SWSH068. The article is a forward-looking announcement (published 2020-08-28) of the in-store availability start; it does not name Ronflex individually, only 'one of four alternate-art promos'. Same day as the existing English 2020-10-31 value; independently stated in French. Printing caveat: a separate Cosmos-holo SWSH068 print bearing the Vivid Voltage expansion logo was a retailer gift-with-purchase from 13 Nov 2020 (DE Spiele Max/MyToys, IT GameStop, ES, FR PicWicToys per the Bulbapedia text retained in verification/evidence/release-dates-20261011/western-promos.json); this date applies only to the plain Build & Battle promo, so confirm the target printing is not the logo-stamped one.
findings.retentionNote: Public press-release HTML retained with PR contact e-mail addresses replaced by [redacted-contact]; originalSha256 is the hash of the bytes as fetched.

findings.identityMatch: Exact Mainland China 061/S-P 卡比兽 row on 52poke (retained in verification/evidence/release-dates-20261012/taiwan-china-fr-campaign.json, excerpt '061/S-P 卡比兽 “大有可玩”线下活动第二弹、超级赛·西安活动特别包、训练家之旅主题快闪店') names this exact campaign first. The official article's partial promo gallery (raw/pokemoncn-16155-img2..4.png) shows 053/S-P 炎兔儿, 056/S-P 莫鲁贝可, 055/S-P 美纳斯 (same 051-062 S-P range); 061 itself is not pictured in the partial gallery.
findings.notes: Earlier than both previously retained distributions (Shenyang 2023-08-27; Shenzhen 2023-09-16) and than the other two campaigns named in the 52poke row (Xi'an Super tournament announced 2023-09-26/10-12, raw/pokemoncn-search-xian.html; Trainer's Journey pop-up announced 2023-09-13, raw/pokemoncn-search-trainersjourney.html). The first 大有可玩 wave (2023-05-19..21, raw/pokemoncn-event-16253.html) offered no promo pack. Card-to-campaign link depends on the curated wiki row; the official page states only 'random promo card' with a partial gallery. Distribution is via a WeChat-follow giveaway at participating malls.
